event_name: Red Bull Toro Rosso Honda Document 36 Date 27 July 2019 Time 16:50 2019 GERMAN GRAND PRIX 25 - 28 July 2019 The Stewards The Stewards, having received a report from the Race Director, summoned (documents 28 & 29) and heard from the drivers and team representatives, have considered the following matter and determine
offence: Breach of Article 28.13 (a) of the 2019 FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations.
reason: The Stewards reviewed video evidence, heard from the drivers of Car 26 (Daniil Kvyat) and Car 8 (Romain Grosjean) and the team representatives. It was apparent that Car 26 was released from the garage almost simultaneously with Car 8 and that the mechanic releasing car 26 would not have seen car 8 until Kvyat was already moving. While car 8 had to take avoiding action, both drivers agreed that the situation was not significant, and the Stewards determined to take no further action.
stewards: in accordance with Article 15 of the FIA International Sporting Code
title: Decision Car 26 Alleged Unsafe Release
